tasks.title: Option::map
tasks.statement: Write double_opt(x: Option<i32>) -> Option<i32>: double the value inside, leave None as None (without match).

tasks.title: and_then
tasks.statement: Write safe_half(x: Option<i32>) -> Option<i32>: half of the number if it is even, otherwise None; for None — None. Use and_then.
tasks.hint: and_then takes a function that returns an Option.

tasks.title: filter
tasks.statement: Write positive(x: Option<i32>) -> Option<i32>: keep the value only if it is > 0.

tasks.title: unwrap_or_else
tasks.statement: Write name_or_default(n: Option<&str>) -> String: the name, or «nobody#» + the length of the word «nobody» (this is how it is computed lazily) — without match and if.

tasks.title: ok_or
tasks.statement: Write first_or_err(v: &[i32]) -> Result<i32, String>: the first element or Err("empty") (first, copied, ok_or).

tasks.title: Option::zip
tasks.statement: Write both(a: Option<i32>, b: Option<i32>) -> Option<(i32, i32)>: a pair if both are Some, otherwise None (the zip method).

tasks.title: Option::take
tasks.statement: Write pop_front(slot: &mut Option<String>) -> Option<String>: pull the value out of the slot, leaving None (the take method).

tasks.title: map_err
tasks.statement: Write parse_pos(s: &str) -> Result<u32, String>: parse a non-negative number; on an error — Err with the text «bad number: <s>» (map_err).

tasks.title: Result::and_then
tasks.statement: Write parse_and_sqrt(s: &str) -> Result<f64, String>: parse an f64 (error «not a number») and take the square root (error «negative» when < 0). A chain of and_then.

tasks.title: Result → Option
tasks.statement: Write numbers(items: &[&str]) -> Vec<i32>: parse all the strings as i32 and keep only the successful ones (filter_map with ok()).

tasks.title: collect into Result
tasks.statement: Write all_numbers(items: &[&str]) -> Result<Vec<i32>, String>: all strings into numbers or Err(<the first bad string>). Hint: collect can build a Result<Vec<_>, _>.

tasks.title: unwrap_or_default
tasks.statement: Write to_i32(s: &str) -> i32: the number from the string or 0 (parse + unwrap_or_default).

tasks.title: mem::swap
tasks.statement: Write swap_values(a: &mut i32, b: &mut i32): swap the values with the function std::mem::swap.
tasks.hint: std::mem::swap(a, b) takes two mutable references.

tasks.title: Vec::swap
tasks.statement: Write swap_items(v: &mut Vec<i32>, a: usize, b: usize): swap the elements with indices a and b (the v.swap method).
tasks.hint: v.swap(a, b) is a safe exchange of two elements.

tasks.title: mem::replace
tasks.statement: Write set_name(name: &mut String, new: &str) -> String: replace the value and return the old one (mem::replace).

tasks.title: mem::take
tasks.statement: Write drain_all(v: &mut Vec<String>) -> Vec<String>: return all the elements and leave the vector empty (mem::take).

tasks.title: Comparing by several fields
tasks.statement: Write sort_people(v: &mut Vec<(String, u32)>): sort the pairs (name, age) by age in descending order, and for equal ages by name in ascending order (cmp and then).

tasks.title: Reverse
tasks.statement: Write top_three(v: &[i32]) -> Vec<i32>: the three largest in descending order (sort_by_key with Reverse; if there are fewer than three elements — all of them).

tasks.title: clamp
tasks.statement: Write normalize(v: &[f64]) -> Vec<f64>: limit every number to the range [0.0, 1.0] (the clamp method).

tasks.title: Sorting floats
tasks.statement: Write sort_floats(v: &mut Vec<f64>): in ascending order, with NaN at the end (the total_cmp method).

tasks.title: From and Into
tasks.statement: The struct Rgb(u8, u8, u8) is declared. Implement From<(u8, u8, u8)> for Rgb and From<u32> for Rgb (the value 0xRRGGBB), so that Rgb::from(…) and .into() work.
tasks.hint: Shifts >> 16 and >> 8; casting to u8 cuts off the high bits.

tasks.title: FromStr
tasks.statement: Implement FromStr for Point { x: i32, y: i32 }: parse a string like «3,-4» (Err(String) if it is not two numbers separated by a comma). Then "3,-4".parse::<Point>() works.

tasks.title: AsRef<str>
tasks.statement: Write shout(s: impl AsRef<str>) -> String: the string in uppercase with «!» at the end. The function must accept both &str and String.
tasks.hint: s.as_ref() — get a &str from any form.

tasks.title: TryFrom
tasks.statement: Write to_byte(n: i32) -> Option<u8>: n as u8 if it fits (0..=255), otherwise None. Use u8::try_from(n).ok().
tasks.hint: try_from returns a Result; ok() turns it into an Option.

tasks.title: successors
tasks.statement: Write powers_of_two(limit: u64) -> Vec<u64>: the powers of two 1, 2, 4, … not greater than limit (iter::successors + take_while).

tasks.title: from_fn
tasks.statement: Write collatz(n: u64) -> Vec<u64>: the Collatz sequence from n down to 1 inclusive (iter::from_fn with the state in the closure).
tasks.hint: The state is kept in an Option<u64> inside the closure.

tasks.title: chain and zip
tasks.statement: Write interleave(a: &[i32], b: &[i32]) -> Vec<i32>: alternate the elements of a and b (a0, b0, a1, b1, …), the tail of the longer one is appended at the end.
tasks.hint: min of the lengths, a loop over the common part, and the tail.

tasks.title: cycle
tasks.statement: Write repeat_to(v: &[i32], n: usize) -> Vec<i32>: the first n elements of the endless repetition of v (cycle + take); for an empty v — an empty vector.
tasks.hint: cycle() on an empty slice gives an empty iterator.

tasks.title: fold
tasks.statement: Write digits_to_num(d: &[u8]) -> u64: the number made of digits (d = [1, 2, 3] → 123) via fold.

tasks.title: min_by_key and max_by
tasks.statement: Write shortest_longest(words: &[&str]) -> Option<(String, String)>: the shortest and the longest words (by number of characters; on ties — the first for the shortest and the last for the longest, as min_by_key and max_by_key do). For an empty slice — None.
